caption: The drawing depicts a single stoneware jar positioned upright in the center of the composition against a plain, light beige background. The jar is cylindrical with slightly curved sides that taper inward toward a thick, outwardly rounded rim at the top, which is depicted in a darker brown. The body of the jar is a light, earthy beige color, with speckles and variations in tone suggesting the texture of ceramic or stoneware. On the upper right side of the jar’s body, there is a small decorative blue motif consisting of simple lines and circular shapes. The underside of the jar is not visible, and the interior opening is shown as a shaded dark area. There is a small, handwritten label in red ink below and to the left of the jar, reading “Osaka Potoware.” The composition is minimal, featuring only the jar and the blank background.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
